name: AI Song Maker Online
tagline: AISongsMaker is a free AI song maker workspace for your own lyrics, ideas, or licensed audio; generate, compare, and keep drafts you like.
description: AISongsMaker is an AI song maker that turns a short prompt, your own lyrics, or audio you have the rights to use into listenable song drafts. You can generate several versions, compare them, and keep the takes you like in Projects and Favorites. New accounts get limited free credits; downloads and commercial-use rights depend on the current plan.
